Content Specialist - PR & Journalism

Do you have a background in journalism or PR? Then you already have a head start. At Bonzer, your sense for a good story, sharp angles and solid research is exactly what makes content stand out – on Google, in the media and in the answers AI models give.

We're looking for someone who wants to be among the best content people in Scandinavia – and who sees every piece as a chance to get sharper.

About us

Bonzer is a specialised SEO agency passionate about helping businesses strengthen their online presence and visibility across Google and AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. That’s why we focus on crafting strong, organic strategies and SEO results tailored to our clients’ needs, goals and ambitions.

At Bonzer, we support our clients’ overall business and marketing strategy through in-depth analyses, strategic roadmaps and effective SEO sprints. We value close, honest and transparent relationships, both externally with our clients and internally with each other.

The role

As our new Content Specialist, you'll join a content team we're actively building and strengthening. You'll produce high-quality content for Bonzer's clients – content built to rank at the top of Google, earn coverage in the media and be visible in AI search platforms and language models.

Search is changing rapidly. More and more people find answers, products and brands through AI models. That's why journalism and PR skills are more valuable in SEO than ever. You'll work hands-on with this shift every day, helping our clients grow through organic visibility.

We want someone who's naturally drawn to exploring how new AI tools can make their day-to-day sharper. Not because someone tells you to, but because it's genuinely fun to figure out what's suddenly possible.

We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What we expect is that you bring strong craft, high standards and the drive to keep raising the bar.

Your responsibilities

• You'll create different types of high-quality content for our clients, such as blog posts, product and category texts, press releases, and graphic and interactive formats. Every piece combines strong craftsmanship with a clear strategic purpose.

• You'll drive Digital PR for our clients: find newsworthy angles in data and client insights, pitch stories and land coverage in global media.

• You'll create content that AI models pick up, cite and trust, helping our clients become visible not only on Google but also in the answers AI search platforms give.

• You'll explore how new AI tools can make your day-to-day work sharper – and share what you learn with the team.

• You'll own your tasks from start to finish. You'll keep an overview of multiple tasks and deadlines, take responsibility for the quality of your work and contribute to your team's shared goals.

Who you are

You have experience within journalism, PR, communication, content creation or similar areas.

Above all, you're a genuinely strong writer and know what makes a story newsworthy**.** You know how to create texts that are engaging, well-structured and tailored to different audiences and formats – and you take pride in delivering quality every time, even under deadline pressure.

Experience with SEO isn't a requirement, but we want to see a genuine interest in AI search, visibility in AI models and Digital PR. Just as important, you're curious about AI as a tool, not just as a topic.

You're organised and structured, and you take responsibility for your own performance. That's why we're looking for new colleagues who thrive in a collaborative environment, value community and share our values, so that together we can strengthen each other and the company.

You have high standards for your own work – you seek out feedback, study the best in the field and enjoy improving yourself. We value your character, craftsmanship and teamwork above all.

You'll thrive here if…

• you get a kick out of seeing your story in the media or your text at the top of Google

• you see feedback as the fastest way to grow

• you like a dynamic day where no two days are the same

Language requirements: You must speak and write fluently in Danish and English, and be a resident of Denmark, as the role is based at our Copenhagen office. Excellent Danish skills are essential for creating content for our Danish clients, and English is our primary working language across markets.

What we offer

• Dedicated support from day one

• Mentorship and skill development

• Working with exciting clients and brands

• Rapid development and career opportunities

• Valuable insight into SEO and the latest developments in AI-driven search

• Responsibility and independent tasks from day one

• Close collaboration with experienced and specialised colleagues

• A strong team culture with regular events and activities

• A growing team of 50 specialists across Denmark, Sweden and Norway

• An office in the centre of Copenhagen

How to apply

If you are interested in the role of Content Specialist at Bonzer, please upload your CV.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait. Expected start: December 2026.

We will get back to you directly if we see a potential match and invite you to a short introductory interview.

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

• First interview

• Second interview with case

• Final interview

We look forward to receiving your application!

Best regards,

Team Bonzer

**Your impact begins here

**As Accounting Manager, you will take full ownership of accounting and tax activities for your area in Business Area (BA) West and become the trusted first point of contact for the local Finance & Operations (F&O) Head and Line of Business. You will keep financial reporting accurate, timely and compliant, especially at month-end and year-end, and help make accounting simpler and more digital. Your work gives local teams the clarity to make decisions and keep moving at pace.

**What You’ll Bring

**You combine strong technical accounting with the confidence to partner with the business and challenge constructively.

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• 5–8 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting, auditing or a comparable background.

• Solid experience in accounting and financial reporting, including month-end and year-end closing.

• Strong technical accounting skills and the ability to handle complex accounting matters.

• Experience performing financial controls and working within a control framework.

• Strong stakeholder-management and business-partnering skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting topics clearly to Finance and non-Finance colleagues.

• Knowledge of SAP.

• A structured, analytical and detail-oriented approach, and the ability to prioritise and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

• A proactive, collaborative mindset, with the confidence to take ownership.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be accountable for the quality of accounting in your area and a visible partner to the people who depend on it.

• Take full accounting responsibility for your assigned area, with the tax activities that go with it.

• Act as first point of contact for the local F&O Head and Line of Business, giving accounting advice and business partnering.

• Perform complex accounting tasks during month-end close (MEC) and year-end close (YEC), delivering accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting.

• Carry out financial controls and make sure control activities are completed effectively and on time.

• Investigate accounting issues, identify risks and drive them to resolution.

• Improve accounting processes and ways of working through standardisation, simplification and digitalisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Accounting & Taxation BA West Centre of Excellence (CoE), based in Copenhagen (Ørestad), and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation CoE. The CoE is responsible for accounting and tax across nine affiliates in 11 countries: Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal.

The team includesAccounting Managers and controllers who act as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates, while two positions focus on the Business Area as a whole. Your closest partners will be the local F&O Head and Line of Business for your area, alongside colleagues across the wider Accounting & Taxation organisation. Together you build standardised, efficient ways of working that support high-quality financial management.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with clear expectations for the quality and timeliness of your work. You will grow by working across markets, stakeholders and finance disciplines, and by contributing to how accounting is improved and digitalised across Business Area West. You will be supported by colleagues who give and ask for honest feedback so that everyone can perform at their best.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 650,960.00 to 956,860.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to own accounting in your area and partner with the business to deliver high-quality results, upload your CV and apply before 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Your impact begins here

**As Advanced Regulatory Writer, you will help get Novo’s manufacturing processes approved and keep them approved. You will write and manage the product registration documentation that regulators rely on, and help shape the regulatory storyline with project teams across the product lifecycle. Your clear, accurate submissions keep products moving through approval, so treatments can reach the people who need them without avoidable delay.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• An MSc in Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related field.

• 2+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, for example in manufacturing support, clinical or regulatory writing, or Regulatory Affairs.

• Demonstrated knowledge of, or experience with, API regulatory documentation, product registration and compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Strong technical writing skills: you produce clear, concise and complete regulatory documents, and some API process knowledge.

• Meticulous attention to detail, so documents are accurate and complete and submissions are not delayed.

• The ability to manage several regulatory tasks at once, keep to timelines and adapt when priorities change.

• Clear communication of regulatory requirements to stakeholders, and an easy way of working across functions.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience taking part in audits or authority inspections, or in process optimisation and regulatory improvement projects.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the link between regulatory requirements and the people who make our products. Your work helps approvals and changes move forward with clarity.

• Prepare, update and review regulatory submission documents so they meet the requirements of regulatory agencies.

• Answer questions from health authorities.

• Work with Regulatory Affairs, the project manager and process development teams to support the approval and maintenance of drug manufacturing process registrations.

• Advise on manufacturing changes to make sure they comply with regulations.

• Represent regulatory writing in project teams throughout the product lifecycle: give input to the regulatory storyline and to project plans, including timelines for preparing and approving submission documents.

• Share learnings, changes and authority signals with the department, and contribute ideas for regulatory strategies that speed up approval of product and manufacturing process changes.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the API MSAT Project Office, working as the regulatory writing representative in project teams. You will be able to work independently on most tasks, with guidance from more experienced colleagues when you need it.

Your closest internal partners are API MSAT, API manufacturing, CMC development (all including QA), Regulatory Affairs, Global Contract Manufacturing (GCM) and Material MSAT, including primary packaging. Externally, you will work with contract manufacturing organisations (CMOs).

The role is based at the Bagsværd site, with the option to work from Gentofte and Kalundborg. Bringing different expertise together, and speaking up early when timelines or documents are at risk, is how this team moves quickly and gets to a clear decision.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your documents and your voice will count in project teams. You will join cross-organisational networks, project, process and focus groups, and contribute to regulatory optimisation projects. That gives you the chance to broaden your regulatory expertise and build new skills across the value chain, with the support of experienced colleagues.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 to 838,100 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Who you are

We are looking for a dedicated, structured and development-oriented Fulfilment Operations Team Leader to join IKEA Odense. You are passionate about leadership, optimising logistics processes and achieving results through people.

This is a fixed-term position consisting of two exciting assignments. You will initially join our Outbound team, focusing on outgoing online orders, before transitioning to our Inbound team, where the focus will be on incoming goods flow. This will give you the opportunity to work with two key areas of our logistics operation and contribute to creating efficient workflows, high quality standards and great customer experiences.

In both roles, your most important task will be to deliver results through visible leadership, strong collaboration and the continuous development of both employees and processes.

To succeed in this role, it is important that you:

•Have 1–2 years of leadership experience, preferably with a focus on people and team management.

•Are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken.

•Are well organised and able to maintain an overview in a busy and changing environment.

•Are motivated by developing people, creating engagement and achieving strong results through your team.

•Have an analytical and solution-oriented approach to operations, processes and optimisation.

•Ideally have experience in logistics – this is an advantage, but not a requirement.

•Ideally hold a forklift licence or are interested in obtaining one.

You must be comfortable working varying hours depending on your area of responsibility. In Outbound, working hours will be flexible between 06:00 and the evening, while in Inbound, working hours will be 04:00–12:00.

A day in your life with us

During the first part of the position, from approximately January 2027 to May 2027, you will be the Team Leader of our Outbound operation. Together with your team, you will ensure that our online orders are handled efficiently and dispatched to our customers on time.

From May 2027, you will transition to our Inbound team, where you will cover a maternity leave position. Here, your focus will be on ensuring an efficient and well-functioning inbound goods flow, making sure that goods are handled correctly and on time and are available to the rest of our logistics operation.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

•Leading, developing and motivating a team of approximately 20 employees.

•Ensuring efficient daily operations and a stable flow of outgoing online orders and incoming goods.

•Optimising outflow, workflows and processes, with a focus on productivity, quality and costs.

•Planning and coordinating resources to ensure that operational targets are achieved.

•Creating a culture focused on continuous improvement, accountability and collaboration.

•Monitoring relevant KPIs, customer satisfaction and operational performance.

•Ensuring employee well-being and actively working with sickness absence and employee retention.

•Ensuring that all work is carried out in accordance with IKEA's applicable safety rules and procedures.

Together as a Team

At IKEA Logistics, we play a central role in creating great customer experiences. Every day, we work to ensure that the right products are available, handled efficiently and moved further through the supply chain, always keeping the customer at the centre of everything we do.

We believe there is always room for improvement and that great results are achieved through engaged employees, clear leadership and strong collaboration.

As a Team Leader, you will play an important role in translating our goals into tangible results in everyday operations. You must be able to provide direction for your team, develop employees' skills and ensure that we continuously find new and better ways of working.

Questions and support? Let's connect!

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Fulfilment Operations Manager Rune Nielsen at rune.nielsen@ingka.ikea.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. All applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Additional information

•This is a fixed-term position with 1st of January 2027 as expected start date until summer 2028.

•The position is based on an average of 37 hours per week.

•From January to May 2027, working hours will be flexible between 06:00 and the evening, depending on operational requirements.

•From June 2027 until summer 2028, working hours will generally be 04:00–12:00.

•You must be willing to work additional hours and overtime when required by operational needs.

•Weekend work approximately every third weekend.

•You must also be willing to participate in the store's Duty/Floor management rotation at selected times.

•Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis

• Please apply latest on the 1st of december.

The conference floor is where deals start. The dinner is where trust is built. The clip is what 10,000 people see the next morning. Own all three.

**About The Job

**GetWhy is the end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform trusted by the world’s most influential brands, including eBay, Arla, Warner Brothers and The Coca Cola company, to understand their customers at scale. We’re backed by $40M in Series A funding and scaling aggressively into the enterprise market.

In our category, events aren’t a nice-to-have. They are a strategic weapon. Industry conferences, hosted experiences, executive dinners and brand activations are where relationships form, pipeline is built, and GetWhy cements its position as the category leader in AI-powered qualitative research.

We’re hiring our first Lead, Global Events & Community to own how GetWhy shows up in the world. This is a high-ownership role for someone with taste, commercial instinct and relentless execution. You’ll design experiences enterprise buyers actually want to attend, turn every event into content that travels far beyond the room, and build the playbook that lets GetWhy show up brilliantly on every continent.

What you’ll do

Own the global event strategy

• Set GetWhy’s global events strategy with the marketing leadership, from tentpole industry conferences (IIEX, ESOMAR, Quirk’s) to hosted events, executive roundtables and product showcases.

• Plan, produce and execute 15–20+ events per year across Europe, the US and beyond, each tied to clear pipeline, brand and customer goals.

• Own the global events budget, sponsorship negotiations, and relationships with agencies, venues and production partners.

Make GetWhy unmissable at every conference

• Have a strong point of view on world-class conference presence, from booth concept and spatial design to merch and the small details people remember.

• Replace badge-scanning booths with live experiences: let attendees run a real GetWhy study, see AI-moderated interviews in action, and leave with an insight.

• Secure speaking slots and sponsorships that put GetWhy at the centre of the industry conversation.

Put customers on stage

• Build a flagship GetWhy-hosted event where customers present the work they’ve done with GetWhy and show other brands how to do the same.

• Recruit and prepare customer and executive speakers, and make sure every GetWhy representative on stage or on the floor is briefed and on message.

Own the side events and intimate moments

• Design VIP dinners, executive roundtables and side events around major conferences, where the real relationships are built.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account-based events that move specific deals and expansions forward.

Run the content machine

• Capture on-site content at every event, including video, photos and short clips that show GetWhy’s presence on the ground.

• Turn events into social media content, such as live posts, recaps, reels and LinkedIn stories, working with the wider marketing team.

• Conduct on-site interviews with customers, speakers and industry leaders, creating content for social, the website and sales enablement.

• Make sure every event keeps working for weeks afterwards through recaps, clips and follow-up campaigns.

Turn events into revenue

• Build the pre- and post-event engine: invitations, promotion, lead capture, qualification and a seamless handoff to Sales.

• Track and report on pipeline, ROI, reach and brand impact for every event, and double down on what works.

Build the playbook

• Create scalable playbooks and “event in a box” toolkits so local teams and partners can host on-brand GetWhy events anywhere.

• Grow the events function over time, including freelancers, agencies and future hires.

• Stay ahead of new event formats and technologies, and bring the best of them to GetWhy first.

Who you are

You’re not looking for an event coordination role. You’re a builder who sees events as the highest-leverage channel in a B2B enterprise sale, and you want to prove it on a global stage.

• 3–6+ years in event marketing, field marketing or experiential marketing for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech or a high-growth scale-up.

• A portfolio of standout events, with a track record that ties them directly to pipeline and revenue.

• Real taste. You know what makes a booth, a dinner or a keynote memorable, and you can explain why.

• Commercially minded. You think about pipeline and impact, not just logistics.

• A poster, not a scroller. Social media is second nature, and you know what makes an event clip worth watching.

• Comfortable behind a camera and in front of people. You can film, run an interview and do basic editing on the fly.

• A strong operator who can run several events in parallel across time zones without dropping quality.

• An excellent communicator who can brief a designer, negotiate with a venue and pitch an executive audience.

• Comfortable with CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

• A willing traveler. You go where the events are and you bring the energy.

Bonus points

• Experience from the insights, market research or MarTech industry. You know the conferences, the audience and the culture.

• Experience at an AI-native research company or a frontier AI or tech company known for its events.

• You’ve built an events function from scratch, including playbooks, processes and measurement.

• You’ve produced a flagship owned event or customer conference.

• A network of event organisers, venues and production partners across Europe and the US.

What we offer

• A fast-scaling, ambitious company where events are a core growth engine, not an afterthought.

• The chance to build GetWhy’s global events function from the ground up and define how a category leader shows up in the world.

• Real ownership, a seat close to leadership, and the budget and trust to try bold ideas.

• Work with some of the world’s most influential brands as customers, speakers and partners.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events. We work hard, and we celebrate hard.

How to apply

Click apply and upload your CV, LinkedIn profile, and a link to a portfolio of events you’ve produced. Event photos, clips or social posts you’ve made are a big plus.

If we see a match, we’ll invite you to a conversation online or at our office. The process includes a short creative assignment, where you’ll pitch how GetWhy should show up at one of our key industry conferences.

This isn’t the easiest events job out there. It’s the one that will define how a category leader shows up in the world. Let’s build GetWhy together.

jobs.occupation: Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician - Translational and Clin Dev
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about pharmacometrics and model-informed drug development? Do you have experience with translational and clinical population PK/PD modeling and support of regulatory submissions?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician.

We are looking for a hands-on pharmacometrician who combines scientific excellence with strategic thinking and wants broad ownership across programs.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our Pharmacometrics Department supports every asset in the Ascendis portfolio and acts as a strategic partner throughout development, from innovation and early research through translational and clinical development, regulatory submissions, and life cycle management. Each pharmacometrician contributes directly to development strategy and portfolio decisions.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician who can address complex development questions and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You will apply model-informed drug development in rare diseases, where quantitative methods can directly inform trial design, dose selection, and evidence generation in small patient populations. You will gain exposure across translational and development stages and contribute to projects throughout the portfolio, providing broad visibility and influence within the company.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with colleagues in Pharmacometrics, global project teams, external partners, and consultants. You will be joining the growing Pharmacometrics Department and report directly to Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics, who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup. The team includes in-house pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and external consultants working remotely.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• 
Develop model-informed drug development strategies for translational and clinical-stage projects and ensure optimal use of pharmacometric methods to inform trial and program design

• 
Shape regulatory strategy and represent pharmacometrics in global health authority interactions

• 
Inform dose selection, trial design, regulatory strategy, and lifecycle decisions through population PK/PD modeling, simulation, exposure-response analysis, and quantitative benefit-risk assessment

• 
Translate quantitative results into clear recommendations to project teams, senior management, health authorities, external partners or organizations

• 
Plan, document and report pharmacometric analyses in accordance with internal quality standards and global regulatory submission requirements

• 
Strengthen departmental methods, standards and capabilities through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and continued development of the department's modeling and reporting environment

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a PhD, MSc, or equivalent qualification in pharmacometrics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacokinetics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. You have relevant experience with PK/PD modeling and model-informed drug development.

Furthermore, you have:

• Hands-on experience with NONMEM and R applied to population PK/PD model development, simulation, and model-informed drug development

• Strong programming skills and technical expertise to organize, perform, document, and report pharmacometric analyses to submission standard

• Experience with translational and clinical-stage analyses, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose selection, and trial-design questions

Additional experience that would be an advantage:

• Industrial experience supporting regulatory interactions or submissions, including knowledge of relevant FDA, EMA, and ICH expectations for pharmacometric analyses

• Familiarity with LaTeX, Git and reproducible reporting workflows, or experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or automation to pharmacometric workflows

Key competencies:

• You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude

• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key

• You communicate complex quantitative findings clearly, work effectively across disciplines, and balance analytical detail with broader development objectives

• You combine a strong quantitative background with biological and clinical understanding and collaborate effectively with scientists, clinicians, regulatory colleagues, and external partners. Your ability to share knowledge and contribute to common goals will be valued among colleagues

Travel: 5-10 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup, Denmark.

At Factbird, we're redefining how manufacturing runs. By combining hardware, firmware, cloud, and AI, we turn raw production data into real, measurable impact on factory floors around the world. This is a product built by and for people who understand what happens on the shop floor. We’re on a mission to make it easier and faster for manufacturers to work smarter to increase productivity and eliminate waste.

For this mission we're building fast, scaling with purpose, and solving problems that matter. Now, we're looking for an addition to our product management team, who want to bring our product into the future by expanding upon how we create real value on the factory floor.

The position product management plays at Factbird is both high-impact and also hands-on. As a product manager here, you’ll set direction, own the roadmap, and drive execution from idea to launch and beyond. You’ll play a key role in shaping how our platform scales and how our customers succeed.

About the role

You’ll work closely with a dedicated development team and your peer product leaders, and you report to the Director of Product.

Production Insights: As a key platform application the candidate requires a strong PM backbone with a focus on having built products that communicate complex datasets and provide actionable insights to different user groups. To succeed in this role, previous experience from manufacturing industries is a key differentiator for us. Whether you have stood on that shopfloor and owned its numbers yourself or have worked for manufacturing and know exactly what "real value" means to the people running a production line – we take “knowing our customers” very serious for this particular position.

Key Responsibilities

• Turn strategy into shipped products: Define roadmaps, prioritize ruthlessly, and work closely with stakeholders to ensure we solve the biggest problems our customers are facing.

• Lead across disciplines: Act as the glue between product, firmware, cloud, UX, and business stakeholders - making sure everyone is aligned, focused, and moving fast.

• Identify signals in noise: Clarify customer needs, outline their jobs to be done and translate findings into clear and concise user stories.

• Spearhead continuous discovery: Build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to gather key insights.

• Launch, learn, iterate: Drive product launches, gather customer feedback, and continuously evolve features based on real-world usage.

• Own performance & outcomes: Define and track key performance metrics aligned with product objectives.

About you

You have experienced first-hand how a shop floor is operated to ensure targets are met and continuous improvements are realized. You thrive in environments where ownership is high, pace is fast, and impact is visible. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and love turning complexity into clarity, because you've had to do exactly that on a production floor before.

You are curious about technology and are keen to figure out what it enables for people who live and breathe shop floor realities every day. You care deeply about understanding the underlying problem before working on a solution. You want to build products that drive real value, something customers depend on, not just move on to the next shiny thing.

Requirements

• Solid Product Management Experience: You are well-versed in product management frameworks and agile processes and can bring them into play with a practical approach, leveraging frameworks where they create clarity, structure, and speed.

• You've worked hands-on on the shopfloor for a while. You've been accountable for ensuring performance meets expectations by collaborating with the likes of operators, process engineers, continuous improvement leads, and plant or operations managers. This operational depth is what lets you translate real production pain into product decisions, and it is a hard requirement for this specific role — without it, the rest of the role is very difficult to do well. Our products play an essential role in manufacturing operations, and your experience within this field is essential.

• A continuous discovery mindset: You talk to customers constantly, map their jobs to be done, and identify commonalities. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguity until the real problem surfaces.

• Strong data and analytics instinct: Comfortable working with data and understanding how to turn analysis into concrete actions.

• A natural communicator: You speak the language of engineers, designers, operators, and leadership alike, adapting how you communicate to whoever's in the room.

• Driving teams: Proven ability to set and agree direction and goals with R&D teams, driving the team and getting to results in a manner where the team feels proud of the outcome.

Why Factbird?

People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

We’d love to hear from you

If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at **khma@factbird.com

_We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

We're now looking for a Chief Product & Technology Officer to lead our next chapter.

One accountable leader for what we build, why we build it and how we release it.

The Role:

The role translates the company’s growth ambition into an AI-first portfolio built on a scalable, secure and coherent platform, and ensures that it reaches customers predictably and at a high quality bar. The CPTO is both the architect of the portfolio and its foremost ambassador, internally and externally.

You'll own product strategy, technology, architecture and release cadence across our full product portfolio, leading an international product and R&D organization globally.

Reports to Chief Executive Officer; member of the Executive Management Team.

Direct reporst - VP of Technology Engineering; VP Product Management.

📍 Copenhagen HQ preferred

• international role, approx. 40–50 travel days a year.

What You'll Drive:

• Scale Retail platform solution for global enterprise customers and lead our entry into the US market.

• Set the direction for our next-generation hospital platform.

• Take AI from roadmap to recurring revenue, built into the core platform and delivered responsibly.

• Bring several legacy systems together into one coherent, secure cloud platform.

• Build a predictable release rhythm and a data-driven, AI-first engineering culture.

• Shape build, partner or buy decisions and lead product and technical due diligence.

Strategic Priorities:

Three agendas connect directly to growth along two vectors: winning more clinics and customers (points of sale) and expanding what each customer uses and pays for (product depth and ASP). Platform consolidation underpins all three.

• Manage: Global Scaling to Enterprise & US Market Evolve Manage for enterprise scalability, security, integrations and governance, with standardised workflows across clinics and regions. Sequence market entry deliberately rather than opportunistically.

• Next-Generation Hospital Software: Set direction for and deliver a modern, future-proof hospital platform. Define the product configuration needed for broader global expansion without compromising the depth hospital customers require.

• AI: From Roadmap to Recurring Revenue Move planned AI categories from build to commercial launch on time and to a high quality bar. Drive attachment until AI is a differentiator in every deal and a recurring contributor to ARR.

• One Coherent Platform: Reduce the number of legacy systems and build the shared foundation that makes the three agendas above deliverable.

Success Criteria:

First 6–12 Months:

• A clear, prioritised and communicated product and technology roadmap addressing 2 main Goals; Enterprise Expansion & US Market Entry, understood and supported by the Executive Management Team and the Board.

• A decided and initiated plan for next-generation hospital software, built on one coherent foundation.

• A defined target architecture and a legacy consolidation plan with milestones.

• A defined AI approach across the portfolio, with concrete initiatives linked to customer value and ARR potential.

• Clear build-versus-buy principles and a product-led view on M&A opportunities.

• A product and technology organisation with clear roles, one planning rhythm and agreed delivery metrics to increase velocity and throughput.

What You Bring:

• Senior leadership of both product management and engineering (CPTO, CPO, CTO or SVP level) in B2B SaaS or vertical software.

• A record of turning market insight into a portfolio strategy that grows ARR, including pricing and packaging.

• Experience building and leading multinational, distributed teams and developing strong leaders.

• Platform modernisation, legacy consolidation and M&A integration experience.

• Hands-on understanding of where AI creates real customer and business value.

• Credibility with engineers and in C-level customer conversations.

• PE-backed or high-growth experience is a clear advantage; healthtech or regulated industries a plus.

Personal Qualities:

• Strategic: Think in wholes, long horizons and business value, and turn this into concrete, prioritised choices.

• Technology fluent: Credible with architects and engineers, and able to explain technical trade-offs in business terms.

• Commercial: Understand the link between product, sales and earnings, and drive growth through the product.

• Execution-strong: Balance ambition with pragmatic delivery and measurable results.

• Clear communicator: Explain product and technology choices simply and convincingly, and builds buy-in from the Board to the team.

• Empowering leader: Build strong teams and develop people, in line with our values: Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

• Purpose-driven: Motivated by improving access to hearing healthcare.

• Robust: Collaborative, and able to make clear choices when priorities compete.

How We Work:

Agile, direct and non-political. We say it like it is, make the tough calls and like to see people grow and deliver results. Our values are all about C. A. R. E. - Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

What We Offer:

A central value-creation role in an Insight Partners-backed software company with an ambitious growth plan and a clear purpose. The CPTO owns the full product and technology agenda, takes a defining role in the growth journey, and has access to Auditdata’s Management Incentive Programme.

Your journey with us:

We want you to get to know us as well as we get to know you.

• Introductory call (online) with our Talent Partner;

• Value fit meeting (online) with our Chief People Officer, followed by a behavioural profile (such as DISC);

• Executive interview (online) with our Chief Executive Officer;

• Copenhagen visit (in-person): meet the team at our HQ and present a case on a real challenge we’re tackling;

• Final interview (online) with the Board.

Throughout, you’ll get timely feedback and plenty of room to ask your own questions.

We look forward to your application! (please submit your CV in English and why this role interests you)

**Market Director Health and Public Institutions – Buildings & Industry

**__**Lyngby or Aarhus, Odense or Vejle

**_

_**Do you want to help shape some of Denmark's and the Nordic region's most important healthcare, education and public building projects? Can you build trusted relationships with key clients, grow business opportunities, and lead complex pursuits in a market with significant societal impact? And do you combine solid commercial acumen with deep insight into the health and public institutions sector? Then join COWI as our new Market Director for Health & Public Institutions within Buildings & Industry and apply your knowledge and curiosity to enable a better tomorrow.

**_

_**Shape the future of healthcare and public buildings

**_To strengthen COWI’s customer-centric approach, we are looking for a Market Director to drive business development and coordinate sales efforts within Health & Public Institutions in our Buildings & Industry sector.

This is a key role in one of COWI’s strategic growth markets, covering healthcare, education, research, cultural facilities and public development projects across Denmark and the Nordics. You will help position COWI on major hospital developments, universities, public institutions, refurbishment programmes and other complex projects that contribute to the development of society.

What makes this role unique is its pure focus on market leadership, where success is defined by customer value, business growth, and a strong market presence. Working closely with specialists, project managers and technical experts, you will build relationships, identify opportunities and grow COWI’s presence in the market. You will also become part of an experienced business development community that shares best practices and drives commercial excellence across COWI.

As part of a team of 25 experienced market professionals across COWI and Arkitema, you will work at the forefront of our business development efforts. Reporting to the Senior Market Director, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to deepen client relationships, unlock strategic opportunities, and lead pursuits from early engagement through to project win, contributing directly to the continued growth of our business.

With increasing investments in healthcare, public buildings and sustainable transformation, the market offers significant growth potential. Your sector insight, commercial mindset and customer understanding will help position COWI as a preferred partner for public clients and healthcare organisations across the Nordic region.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Grow business development and growth across the Health & Public Institutions market segment by identifying, prioritizing, and converting strategic opportunities.

• Build and maintain close relationships with key customers, partners, and decisionmakers, acting as a trusted advisor and Key Account Manager for selected clients.

• Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, manage Go/No-Go decisions, and drive capture planning for major pursuits and tenders.

Lead and support complex proposal processes, ensuring compelling value propositions and effective collaboration across disciplines and business units.

• Provide direction and coordination for the Business Development team supporting the market segment, ensuring effective collaboration and delivery of market priorities.

• Monitor market trends, upcoming investments, and customer needs to help shape market strategies and long-term growth initiatives.

• Represent COWI externally through customer meetings, industry networks, conferences, and strategic partnerships.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**Like us, you believe that successful business development is built on trust, collaboration and long-term relationships. You are motivated by creating opportunities, understanding customer needs and bringing together the best teams to deliver value for clients and society. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with fellow Market Directors and multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared goals.

To perform well in this role, it is essential that you bring solid market insight and a well-established network within healthcare, public institutions or the built environment sector. Equally important is your ability to build internal alliances and leverage the collective expertise of the organisation rather than acting alone.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background such as engineering, architecture, business or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in business development, client management, or market leadership within healthcare, public institutions, architecture, construction, or engineering consultancy.

• Deep knowledge of public-sector customers, procurement processes, and market dynamics, combined with a well-established professional network.

• Demonstrated skill in building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.

• Experience contributing to large and complex tenders, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

• Demonstrated ability to provide leadership, direction, and coordination across Business Development teams, account managers, and framework agreement holders, ensuring a shared focus on market growth and client development without formal personnel responsibility.

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in both Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and collaboration – because that is what brings out the best in you, both at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people bringing expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Market Director Mikael Voldborg, Buildings & Industry, at mivo@cowi.com, or Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Janne Nielsen, at jane@cowi.com.

Get to know us better on our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we aim to achieve, and what it is like to be part of COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or cover letter required. Please add a short motivation for the role (4–5 lines) at the top of your CV. When it comes to photos, we prefer to form our first impression face to face rather than from a picture. If relevant, please also attach your portfolio.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI – inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair working environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities to thrive and develop. Our leaders act as role models for inclusive leadership and contribute to a culture where diverse perspectives and professional approaches are seen as a strength. We integrate diversity and inclusion into relevant decisions and processes, and when forming teams across architecture and engineering disciplines. We do this because it is part of our values – and simply because it is the right thing to do.

Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and gain hands-on experience across the full deal lifecycle in an international company with ambitious growth plans?

We are looking for an M&A Associate, Corporate Development, to join KK Group and support the execution of our M&A strategy and broader strategic growth agenda. This is an opportunity to work across the full M&A process, from identifying and evaluating potential acquisition opportunities to transaction execution and post-acquisition integration.

You will work closely with key stakeholders across the organization, combining financial analysis with strategic and commercial insights to support important investment decisions.

The role offers early responsibility, broad exposure to M&A and close interaction with senior management within an international group backed by A.P. Møller Holding, where M&A is an important lever for future growth.

The position is based in Copenhagen and requires presence in our Copenhagen office three days per week.

Your role

As an M&A Associate in Corporate Development, your primary responsibility will be to support the development and execution of KK's M&A strategy.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Conduct financial analysis, financial modelling and company valuations to support M&A and other strategic investment decisions.

• Support the execution of M&A transactions, including due diligence, coordination of external advisors, transaction documentation and other deal-related activities.

• Screen and assess potential acquisition targets, including strategic fit, financial performance, valuation and key investment considerations.

• Prepare investment cases, including strategic rationale, financial returns, risks and value creation opportunities.

• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify potential acquisition targets and assess new markets and growth opportunities.

• Work closely with business divisions and relevant functions to assess commercial, financial and operational aspects of potential acquisitions.

• Support post-acquisition integration planning, including identification and assessment of potential synergies.

• Support broader corporate development and strategic initiatives across the Group.

Your profile

We expect you to have 2-4 years of relevant professional experience, preferably from investment banking, corporate M&A, private equity or Big 4 transaction services. Candidates with a background in strategy consulting and strong financial capabilities will also be considered.

In addition, we expect that you have:

• Strong financial and analytical skills, including experience with financial modelling, valuation and financial statement analysis.

• Experience with M&A transactions, financial due diligence or other transaction-related activities.

• A good commercial understanding and the ability to combine financial analysis with strategic considerations.

• Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to develop clear and well-structured decision material.

• A structured and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks and challenge assumptions when relevant.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate financial and strategic conclusions clearly.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across functions, countries and organizational levels.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

We value intellectual curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to take responsibility. You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change, and where you are expected to take initiative, challenge assumptions and contribute actively.

Ready to build your M&A experience, take responsibility early on and contribute to KK Group’s next phase of growth? We would love to hear from you.

JOIN US IN COPENHAGEN TO HUMANISE BRANDS, SPARK HAPPINESS AND ORCHESTRATE INTERNATIONAL CLIENT PARTNERSHIPS

The Role: Driving World-Class Brand Development

Everland is looking for a full-time, on-site International Client Director to join our Copenhagen office

and drive the Client Service role for some of our key international client collaborations.

Being part of our Clients Services team, you will have a key role in our client collaborations, working

alongside Strategy, Creative, and Realisation to ensure our partnerships are as operationally

seamless as they are ambitious and impactful.

Your Mission: To Be "On It"

Your success is measured by the health of the relationship and the excellence of the delivery. You are

a high-level orchestrator of complex work streams, with responsibilities including:

• Service Excellence & Responsiveness: Providing the responsiveness that our clients crave. You are the primary point of contact for the ongoing collaboration, soaking up everyday tasks and solving tactical challenges with pragmatic, "can-do" energy.

• Master of Project Management: You take absolute ownership of the project management fundamentals. You lead the full brand and design development lifecycle, from defining initial scopes and meticulous budgeting to resource planning and timeline precision. You are the guardian of the brief and process, ensuring nothing is left out or to chance.

• Driving & Shaping Partnerships: You manage the full spectrum of client needs. This ranges from leading extensive, long-term brand development programmes to flawlessly coordinating the day-to-day tasks that keep a global brand moving.

• Team Integration: Acting as the operational glue within our teams. You bridge the gap between the strategic intent, the creative vision, and the client’s operational reality, ensuring that every project is delivered on time, on budget, and beyond expectation.

• "Beyond the Brief": Acting as the operational "eyes and ears" with your clients. Because you are so close to the daily work, you identify opportunities to create value beyond the initial scope, proactively proposing ways we can help clients solve their next challenge.

Your Profile: ‘Pro’ with International Outlook and Scandinavian Heart

We are looking for a team player who balances a professional "Director-level" weight with a

flat-hierarchy, sleeves-up mindset.

• The Experience: 10+ years of relevant professional experience. This must include at least 5 years of agency-side experience managing international clients within the consumer goods / FMCG industry.

• The Operational Specialist: You are a project manager by trade and a problem-solver by nature. You have the seniority to sit at the table with senior client stakeholders, but you have never lost your love for the "basics" of a perfectly managed workflow.

• The Commercial Driver: Commercially astute and growth-oriented. You possess a deep curiosity about your clients' business realities, allowing you to shape strategic solutions that truly address their needs while proactively identifying and driving organic growth opportunities for Everland.

• The Mindset: Resilient, energetic, and proactive. You don’t just flag problems; you take ownership. You take pride in "owning the machine" and making complex projects feel effortless for the client.

• The Collaborator: You thrive in a flat organisation. You are an empathic and natural team player who values the collective win over individual ego and understands the "One Team" philosophy across our functions and offices.

• The International: Some client-related travel activity (mainly Europe) must be expected, and your professional English must be flawless as this will be the main language in your client communications. As you will be based in Copenhagen, mastering a Scandinavian language is a nice bonus, but by no means a necessity.

Why Everland?

You will have a central role in an agency where we value freedom, responsibility, and the "One Team"

mindset. You will join a culture that plays to win but never forgets to spark happiness and keep it

human. Here, you will have the space to leave your mark on some of the world’s most famous

consumer brands while helping shape the future of our international Client Service approach.

Practical Information

• How to apply: Apply via LinkedIn or email your application and CV to our Head of Client Services, Emilie Aagreen emaa@everlandagency.com

• Deadline: ASAP – we will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

• Start date: By agreement.

About Everland

We help Humanise Brands to shape culture and drive sustainable value. Based on our human-centric

approach, we help brands grow with Character and Charisma. In everything they do, and everywhere

they are. Our Scandinavian DNA defines our way of working: an inclusive, direct, and ego-free approach to collaboration — with each other, our clients, and other agency partners alike.

Everland is an international brand and design partner specialised in FMCG brand worlds. We deliver

end-to-end expertise across brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, design realisation, and brand

guardianship.

We are proudly independent, entrepreneurs at heart, and consider ourselves challengers on the

international agency scene. This allows us to stay nimble, focused, and deeply committed to the

brands we nurture.

We’re looking for a hands-on finance leader to own and build our finance function as we scale. You’ll work side by side with our founders and leadership team on strategic decisions, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. This is for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and who wants to have a big impact on how we scale in the future.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You’ll be a key strategic leader at Pandektes, shaping our current financial setup and optimising it for scale.

We’re looking for a commercially minded finance leader who thrives in high-growth environments and understands what it takes to scale a company from early traction.

You will own and evolve the finance function end-to-end; from building scalable financial infrastructure to partnering closely with our CEO and board on strategic decisions. You’ll combine sharp financial thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring we have the insights, structure, and capital needed to scale responsibly and ambitiously.

As part of the leadership team you’ll play a key role in scaling Pandektes. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic finance and operational execution.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own and evolve Pandektes’ financial strategy, ensuring our financial setup scales with our growth ambitions

• Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and leadership team on company-wide decisions

• Set up and continuously improve operational finance processes, systems, and controls

• Fully own business performance metrics, in particular providing insight into key SaaS indicators to drive business performance, support strategic decision-making and identify opportunities for profitable growth

• Own company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning

• Work with external partners on accounting, audits, compliance etc.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Significant experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups, ideally in a VC- or PE-backed environment

• Proven track record leading or playing a central role in fundraising (Series A/B/C and beyond) and/or M&A processes

• Solid understanding of operational finance, including setting up finance functions from scratch or early stage

• Deep experience in excel modelling with a proven track record of delivering automation to manual and complicated processes

• Comfort in dealing with transactional level detail where required in advance of automation and process improvement

• Proven experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn financial data into clear business insights

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-moving environments

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• A central office in Copenhagen, where you can work closely with an ambitious and growing team

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_

**AI Engineer

**AI is moving from prototypes to production-ready solutions. The engineers who can take it there matter more than ever.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We're looking for an AI Engineer who is as comfortable in the code as in the data underneath it. Someone who can design, build, and ship AI solutions today, and grow into setting technical direction as the company grows.

On smaller engagements, you may be the only engineer on the project, which means owning it from problem to production yourself. On larger ones, you'll work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where ideas move quickly, and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you'll work on

• 
Designing and deploying AI solutions across domains like finance, operations, and supply chain

Building predictive models, automated workflows, and agentic systems

**

Curiosity, taste and builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**Benefits

**

Your Mission

You’ll be the person who makes sure Klimate’s numbers are accurate, on time and a reliable source of truth. As our Finance Manager, you’ll own the books, the close and the reporting, as well as the data behind them. You’ll make sure what goes into our finance reports is correct, traceable and something leadership can rely on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both finance and data. The foundation is finance: closing the books, reconciling balances and working with our external bookkeepers and auditors. Alongside that, you’ll use SQL, BI and automation, including AI, to validate data across systems, remove manual steps and improve how finance and operations work together. If you like figuring things out and building the solution yourself, there’s a lot of room to do that here.

Finance at Klimate is closely tied to the business. Every contract, credit delivery and supplier payment shows up in the numbers, so you’ll get a front-row view of how the company actually runs. You’ll work side by side with our CFO on strategic matters, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. You’ll have a big impact on how we scale.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Implement Consulting, Nykredit, Copenhagen Airport and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What You'll Do

In your first 3–6 months: keep the numbers right and make the data trustworthy

• Learn Klimate’s commercial and accounting flows from contracts and allocation through invoicing, payments, credit delivery, revenue recognition and balance-sheet treatment.

• Own the month-end and year-end close from start to finish. You’ll work with our external bookkeeper and make sure the final numbers are right, keep payables and receivables on track, follow up on late payments, and support the annual audit.

• Be the quality gate for our external bookkeepers. Give them the right input, check their output, and make sure what reaches the CFO is correct.

• Deliver practical improvements to priority finance/data flows and reporting processes, reducing manual hand-offs and reconciliation where possible. This includes establishing a documented discrepancy-management process.

• Spot the first manual, error-prone steps in our workflows and start fixing them.

• Support with operational and ad hoc tasks that keep the business running smoothly.

From there: build what’s missing and give management the full picture

• Build the dashboards and overviews leadership uses to steer the company, from cash and margins to carbon-credit stock.

• Collaborate closely with the CFO on management reporting. Support budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning.

• Decide how new deal types, supplier agreements and carbon-credit purchases should be handled in our accounting, and make sure the treatment holds up at audit.

• Set up and continuously improve our finance processes, systems and controls. Automate wherever it makes sense, using whatever tools fit, AI included.

• Own reliable, traceable datasets and reporting that support finance and cross-functional decisions.

• Lead a prioritised roadmap for improving end-to-end data flows and related processes across finance, purchasing, allocation and stock. Collaborate with technical colleagues on integrations and data-models, including bringing AI-supported automations into our workflows.

Requirements and Skills

Must-haves

• Solid accounting experience, including owning the books for a whole entity, with a strong understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. You take pride in reconciliations that tie out, and you always trace discrepancies back to their source.

• Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

• Advanced Excel modelling skills, practical SQL experience such as writing queries and joining datasets, and a good understanding of BI tools.

• Experience with automating workflows, tasks or reporting, and using AI in practice. You’ve taken manual, complicated processes and made them faster, simpler or automatic.

• Financial analysis skills and the ability to turn data and numbers into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

• Professional English is required. Being able to read and understand Danish is preferred.

Nice-to-have

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, VAT and statutory reporting requirements.

• Experience from a smaller company, with hands-on internal finance ownership.

• Knowledge of carbon credit and allowance allocation is a plus.

• Experience and interest in climate, sustainability or carbon markets is highly valued.

Who You Are

• Reliable and trustworthy, with high integrity. You check your own work and make sure the underlying data and the reporting agree.

• Self-driven and you follow through. You see tasks through to completion and ask for input along the way when you need it.

• Energised by a blank page. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building structure where there isn’t any yet.

• Curious about the business. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do, not just report them.

• A clear communicator. You work well across teams, and you’re not afraid to hold others accountable. You have the judgement to know when to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

What We Offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Weekly wrap up sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & Logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP

Job level (internal scale): Level 8 - Junior Expert (A developing professional who demonstrates potential and aptitude in a specific area of expertise. They possess foundational knowledge and skills, acquired through education, training, and practical experience. Typically guided by a Senior Expert and/or mentor)

What to include in your application

• Your CV and a short cover letter (PDF) - please highlight in the Cover Letter how you are combining finance and data or automations in your work

• Please leave out photos and identifying characteristics such as age, gender, nationality, etc.

Our hiring process

• 30 min intro interview with our People & Culture Partner

• Interview and short assignment or case with CFO + a team member

The final candidate will have:

• Final conversation with our CEO, Mads Emil

• Offer

How to apply: If you're interested in the role, please apply by filling in this form and selecting “Finance Manager - Data & BI”.

Equal Opportunities

Klimate is committed to equal opportunities for all people and ideas.

Even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and strive to ensure an objective selection process.
